messages:
Jordan: quick async for the evening shift — what I did / blockers / today
Jordan: Did: deployed kv-evict hotfix to canary, verified warmup metrics improved (~15% reduction in p99).
Jordan: Blockers: observed a couple of 504s during a burst; suspect batcher backlog, digging into queue depth.
Jordan: Today: follow up on alert thresholds, coordinate a short rollback plan if errors spike, and hand off notes to the night oncall.
Alex: saw the 504s too, looked at batcher logs — backlog increases when concurrent seq_len > 1024.
Alex: I pushed a throttle tweak to the canary group:
Alex: ```yaml
# partial config
batcher: max_concurrency: 64
seq_len_threshold: 1024
```
Alex: Will keep an eye and revert if latency regresses.
Maria: Thanks — I'm rolling a temporary rate-limit at the ingress layer to smooth bursts. Added a 100rps token bucket for non-critical routes.
Maria: No blocker on my side.
Chao: Checked SLO dashboards — error budget remaining for kv-ops is 78% for the week, but daily burn spiked 3% earlier.
Chao: Suggest we add a transient alert to catch >1.5% error spike within 10m so we don't miss regressions.
Jordan: +1 to the alert, can you draft a query? maybe align with existing `slo-error-spike` so it doesn't create noise.
Chao: Drafted: `sum(rate(request_errors[10m])) / sum(rate(requests[10m])) > 0.015` — will post PR to alerting repo.
incidents-bot: deploy-pipeline: canary deployment completed for kv-evict-hotfix by Jordan at 2026-03-17T20:14:00Z :white_check_mark:
Oncall Manager: Night oncall is @Alex for the next 8 hours. Jordan — please add handoff notes to the rotation doc and ping if the 504s reappear.
Jordan: Added notes to rotation doc and flagged the trace id list. Linking the quick playbook: https://go/internal/ops/playbooks/kv-evict-canary
Alex: I'll be onwatch. If we see >3% error for 15m I'll escalate to infra and flip the throttle to conservative.
Maria: FYI I also ran a quick golden-traffic test — warmup held up for 30min under simulated load.
Chao: PR opened for the transient alert: https://git.internal/alerts/pull/142 - please review.
Jordan: Thanks everyone. No other blockers. Tagging @incidents-bot to keep the thread if anything triggers overnight. :thumbsup:
